expected.quote: Managers spend most of Monday building orders, and stockouts on fast sellers still happen by Wednesday
expected.statement: Store managers spend most of Monday manually building replenishment orders, and fast sellers still stock out by Wednesday.

expected.quote: Store sales data cannot leave the EU
expected.statement: Store sales data must stay in the EU, so the assistant runs in the Frankfurt cloud region.

expected.quote: orders have to be locked by 14:00 on the day before delivery
expected.statement: Replenishment orders must be locked by 14:00 on the day before delivery.

expected.quote: the inventory feed is refreshed nightly and is accurate to within two percent
expected.statement: The inventory feed is refreshed nightly and accurate to within two percent.

expected.quote: to pilot with the twelve stores in the Rhine-Main region first
expected.statement: The pilot starts with the twelve stores in the Rhine-Main region.

expected.quote: Managers must be able to edit any suggested order line before they submit the order
expected.statement: Store managers can edit any suggested order line before submitting the order.

expected.quote: every suggested line needs a short reason, like promotion next week or sales trending up
expected.statement: Every suggested order line shows a short reason.

expected.quote: a weekly report of how often managers changed the suggestions
expected.statement: A weekly report shows how often managers changed the suggestions.
